nesnd_postwar_sih_title: The Army of Shu Enters Nanjing
nesnd_postwar_sih_desc: 南京已入我军之手，郑氏朝廷无力再维持南方的统治。蜀军起兵时以反吴为号，如今却必须决定天下由谁来统治。有人请求迎回朱氏天子，也有人劝蜀王承继汉统，自立新朝。

Nanjing is in our hands, and the Zheng court can no longer hold the south together. Shu rose against Wu; victory has now placed the succession before its ruler. Some urge the return of the Ming sovereign. Others would have the Prince of Shu establish a Han dynasty of his own.
nesnd_postwar_hna_desc: 襄阳将士以反吴复明为号南下，如今礼议院与各省都在等候新的国体。朱氏复位可以重续明统，共和派却不愿再把国家交给一家一姓。旧日士大夫对于共和政体的疑惧，也不会随着郑氏的失败一并消失。

The army of Xiangyang marched south under the banner of restoring Ming. The Assembly of Rites and the provinces now await a decision on the government. Restoring the Zhu would renew the dynasty’s authority, but republicans refuse to entrust the country to another ruling house. The gentry’s distrust of a republic has survived the fall of Zheng power.
nesnd_postwar_gng_desc: 淮国宗室仍承朱氏皇统。南京既定，朝臣请淮王正皇帝位，重建明廷的号令。战争留下的分裂尚待弥合，礼议院与各省都将见证这个重新执掌天下的朝廷。

The ruling house of Huai bears the Zhu imperial lineage. With Nanjing secured, the court petitions its prince to take the imperial title and restore Ming authority. The divisions left by war remain, and the Assembly of Rites and the provinces will judge the restored court by what follows.
nesnd_postwar_restore_ming_option: Recall the Zhu and restore the Ming court.
nesnd_postwar_restore_ming_tt: 迎回在世的原明朝天子；若天子已故，则奉其在世的合法继承人继位，恢复大明国号。
Recall the surviving deposed Ming emperor, or his surviving lawful heir if the emperor is dead, and restore the Ming name.
nesnd_postwar_great_han_option: Let the house of Han rise again.
nesnd_postwar_great_han_tt: 更改国号为大汉，由本国现任君主继续统治。
Adopt the name Great Han, retaining our current sovereign.
nesnd_postwar_hna_republic_option: 天下不是一家一姓的私产。
The country belongs to no ruling house.
nesnd_postwar_hna_republic_tt: 建立共和国。部分士大夫拒绝承认新政体，共和派则将扩大在知识分子与小市民中的影响。
Establish a republic. Sections of the gentry will resist its authority, while republican influence among the intelligentsia and urban middle classes grows.
nesnd_postwar_gng_option: 奉淮王为帝，复大明之号。
Raise the Prince of Huai to the Ming throne.
nesnd_postwar_gng_tt: 由淮国本支的在世朱氏君主继承帝位，恢复大明国号。
Restore the Ming name under Huai’s own surviving Zhu sovereign.
nesnd_postwar_wait_option: The succession must be considered again.
nesnd_postwar_wait_tt: 目前没有合适的在世继统人选，暂不改变国体或君主。
No eligible living successor is available. Leave the constitution and ruler unchanged for now.
